newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 6 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 6 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: An auction of T-bills worth six billion crowns was oversubscribed, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of six-month T-bills worth 1.2 billion crowns was 4.72 percent.
The office received bids for 8.64 billion crowns for the six-month issue and accepted three bids out of 29.
The average rate of an auction of 4.8 billion crowns worth of one-year T-bills was 4.93 percent, the office said.
It received bids for 15.59 billion crowns for the year issue and accepted one bid out of 56.
